Programs or Services funded/purchased with 340B funds:

340B savings helped fund Vision, Dental, and School-Based Services that operate at a loss (>$2m) and would not be offered without support from 340B profits

Reinvesting 340B profit directly back into patient care to address Social Determinants of Health (SDOH) for patients with complex chronic conditions, including but not limited to patient navigation support, care coordination, clinical pharmacy support, health coaching, mobile phlebotomy, lifestyle interventions to improve patient outcomes, and additional direct reduction of drug costs beyond the sliding fee scale for patients facing financial hardships that would prevent them from otherwise accessing their medication.
Other uses of 340B funds not otherwise listed above:

PrimaryOne Health serves a medically underserved population in central Ohio, and our patient census is comprised of a majority of uninsured and Medicaid patients.  We utilize the 340B drug discount program to support our pharmacy operations, making pharmacy services and medications accessible for individuals who would otherwise face barriers to care.  We also use 340B savings to support our sliding-fee scale for to make pharmacy and medical services available to low-income patients and pass the any remaining savings directly through to patients through our dental, vision, and school-based clinics along with funding non-covered services to address SDOH for patients facing complex, chronic diseases.
